payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over crosswords, using binomial coefficients and powers of 1/2 to compute probability that exactly i crosswords are solved, summing contributions to expected value.
payload.rationale: Solution uses combinatorial formulas (factorials, inverse factorials, powers of 1/2) without explicit DP table; it directly computes expected value by summing over possible 'extra second' counts. This fits dp_counting_combinatorics as it involves counting combinations modulo MOD, though no DP state transitions are present.
